set.body:
Run the accepted optimizer through the frozen external protocol and make the evidence durable.

Acceptance criteria:
AC-433-01: Scheduled and manually dispatched automation installs or pulls only pinned required comparators, verifies digests and dataset checksums, and fails closed when required evidence is unavailable.
AC-433-02: Runs include declared warm-up and repeated measurements, isolated output directories, stage timing, peak RSS, temporary bytes, deterministic checksums, and complete failure records.
AC-433-03: Archived receipts contain protocol version, source revision, dirty-state flag, environment, JVM and Node versions where applicable, comparator versions or digests, raw per-frame metrics, aggregates, and logs.
AC-433-04: The generated audit separates absolute correctness, comparative accuracy, image fidelity, runtime, memory, and unavailable optional evidence and exposes every material loss.
AC-433-05: The predeclared release pass rule is evaluated mechanically. Any waiver names the exact scenario and metric, gives a technical rationale, and blocks unqualified superiority claims.
AC-433-06: A canonical clean-revision receipt, not an uncommitted or locally ignored result directory, is linked from the implementation status and the mig-430 completion note.
set.title: Automate the comparison court and archive canonical release receipts
